patch_requests.patch:
In SubmitMagmawBloodlustCandidate replace
    std::optional<LustWindow> const lustWindow =
        SelectLustWindow(board, headWindow);
with
    std::optional<LustWindow> const lustWindow =
        SelectLustWindow(board, headWindow,
            cohort->Config.ValidationRouteScenarioId);
The 3-argument overload (BotMagmawBloodlustTiming.h) keeps the legacy blackwing_descent_10n_magmaw_diagnostic shard on its pre-Mangle lead (b5 unchanged). Canonical blackwing_descent_10n_magmaw_c<N>_diagnostic cohorts lust on the first exposed head, as the T11 references do. tests/test_magmaw_bloodlust_timing.py already accepts either call form.

open_items: Live T11 c0 run still needed: first-ever c0 head window, hook riders (Retribution plus Assassination, both melee) and a third parasite wave (3 of 7 T11 references have one). The r02 c0 kills ended at 91-95 s, before the head.
Sole-BDK survival through Mangle at T11 health (about 190k). The T11 BDK reference casts Icebound Fortitude 19.5 s into Mangle; the bot pre-casts it 1.5 s before. Not changed without evidence.
Healer mana over about 150 s with two healers (Holy Paladin and Discipline Priest). Needs the healer-mana heartbeat readout (diag Q3) before any Magmaw healer change.
The direct-target pre-boss refusal (EvaluateDirectTarget) is available, but the generic future_encounter_target_forbidden already covers direct offense, so no patch requests it.
Class owners: align Combustion, Vendetta, Metamorphosis/Doomguard and DRW with the exposed head, as the T11 references do. Assassination cast rate is 23.6 cpm in r02 against 33.1 WCL.
risks: Head-only lust means no lust at all on a c0 attempt that ends or wipes before the head is exposed. Every T11 reference lasts at least 16 s past the Mangle release.

The 5-yard chase margin is a bot tolerance. It can refuse Felstorm while the tank still holds a drudge near its spawn (18.9 yards from Magmaw), which costs a little warlock trash DPS but not boss DPS.
EvaluateUnitArea runs five grid searches (80 yards) per call. It is wired only at the ready-Felstorm gate, so it costs nothing per tick for other spells.
validation_neutrality: The legacy Magmaw b5 shard is unchanged. Its raid target, WCL manifest and timelines are untouched, and the 2-argument SelectLustWindow keeps the pre-Mangle lead for blackwing_descent_10n_magmaw_diagnostic. The Magmaw guard only refuses area spells that would reach an un-engaged Magmaw part, and the legacy roster has no Felguard. Stonecore and Phase-8 calibration never observe a Magmaw part, so the guard is inert there. No native boss value, scoreboard target, sidecar or reference changed.
